verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only account-based sign-in: `/login` for provider accounts or subscriptions, and multiple accounts per provider. No item mentions configuring a provider API key or an environment variable as an alternative to account login. API-key authentication is a fair axis for a coding agent that calls model providers, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login
